messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 42):
"""
Further, a notice period of 90 days has been provided to every existing policyholder prior to withdrawal of the Product (Not applicable to Life Insurers).” Place Name and Signature of the principal officer Company’s seal Date: 43 Annexure-6 Sl. No. Circular Reference Description 1) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/193/07/2020 dated 22.07.2020 Master Circular on Standardization of Health Insurance Products 2) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/194/07/2020 dated 22.7.2020 Consolidated Guidelines on Product Filing in Health Insurance Business 3) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/225/08/2020 dated 28.08.2020 Master Circular on Standardization of Health Insurance Products-Corrigendum 4) IRDA/HLTH/ADVT/CIR/017/01/2015 dated 21-01-2015 Submission of Advertisement application through Business Analytics Project (BAP) – Health Module 5) IRDAI/HLT/MISC/CIR/95/04/2020 dated 18.04.2020 Norms on settlement of health insurance claims. 6) IRDAI/HLT/MISC/ORD/18/01/2021d ated 29.01.2021 Health Insurance Forum (HIF) – Reconstitution 7) IRDAI/HLT/REG/MISC/199/07/2021 dated 23.7.2021 Extension of the timelines for complying with standards and benchmarks specified due to Covid-19 pandemic.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"How many days notice must be given to existing policyholders before a product is withdrawn?","answer":"Existing policyholders must be given a notice period of 90 days before the product is withdrawn.","facts":["notice period of 90 days","existing policyholder","withdrawal of the Product"]},{"question":"Is the 90‑day notice requirement applicable to life insurers?","answer":"No, the 90‑day notice period is not applicable to life insurers.","facts":["Not applicable to Life Insurers","notice period of 90 days"]}]}
